about: Splicing track SP-2 (docs/phases/splicing-track.md; logic/genes.js). A Gene is a kit part (partKits.json) with the donor it came from (a kitBuilds.json rig: its species, weight and colour): Billy.graft is { slot: "part@donor" }. kinds: the trait each part kind (partKits.json parts.kind) brings; traits: what a trait does, as effect rows on the Billie that wears it (logic/effects.js fxOfBillie); parts: a part's dominant type (it becomes the second type) and, from SP-4, the move it teaches; stability: what a foreign part costs and the limit; unstable: a splice past the limit. wild (SP-3): the share of a run place's wild Billies that are a Graft (one foreign part from a Billie of the same place) or a Chimera (chimeraParts of them), escaped (an Augment: unused until SP-5), and the DNA a beaten one pays. A kind's word names its part in text ("a shark's tail"). bank (SP-4, logic/gene-bank.js): the Gene Bank's levels (buildings.json genebank; each level's Stability limit and the slots it splices), what a splice costs in DNA (base + perCost x the Gene's Stability cost), and the chance an egg keeps each parent's spliced slot. A kind's or part's field is the field move (fieldMoves.json) a Billie wearing it can use, as if it were of that move's type. Every trait, number and dominant type is a PLACEHOLDER until the owner sets them (the track's Ask me before).
